Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Catherine’s father-in-law was “Rupert II” based on a search snippet without verifying the actual article content or reconciling conflicting sources. This misinterpretation of the web snippet (and failure to cross-check against the Wikipedia page stating “son of Rupert III of the Palatinate”) led to an incorrect identification amid ordinal confusion (Rupert II vs. Rupert III).
